directory_policies.notes.7: English policy: University limited/full status: TOEFL legacy 79/103, TOEFL new scale 4.0/5.0, IELTS 6.5/7.5 and DET 115/135. Scores must be within two years of enrollment; program-specific rules, exemptions and placement conditions still need review.

fact_summary: University English thresholds distinguish limited from full admission and require enrollment-anchored validity; these are displayed as policy context, not complete program eligibility.
